status: Strategy A crustal-block and time-indexed plate reconstruction; kinematic necessary-condition model, not a mantle-convection simulation

reference_frame.proposal4_application: Reconstruct in Earth-reference coordinates first, then apply the fixed Proposal 4 global reorientation. The Proposal 4 rotation is not plate motion.
reference_frame.method: Inherited GPlates rigid-plate motions for old nuclei; explicit finite relative rotations for synthetic marginal blocks; deforming networks at persistent collisional/junction boundaries.

inherited_rigid_blocks.role: eastern rigid core on the same late-Cenozoic rotation circuit as C3 west
old shelf/microcontinental block with slow residual motion relative to C3 east
old western foreland/platform on the same late-Cenozoic rotation circuit as C4 core
old northeastern platform on the same late-Cenozoic rotation circuit as C4 core
old continental nucleus and rifted margin parent

deforming_networks.tectonic_style: microcontinental fragments plus arc crust within a transpressional/subduction-transform junction
deforming_networks.note: The province is not rigidly welded to both continents. Its central block is welded to C1 while continuing C1-C2 relative motion is absorbed in the southern deforming boundary.

deforming_networks.tectonic_style: broad old foreland and microcontinental fragments cut by a younger collisional suture/thrust network
deforming_networks.note: The land corridor may remain continuous while small convergence is accommodated by thrusting and strike-slip deformation.

deforming_networks.tectonic_style: opposed old continental shelves and microcontinental highs separated by a shallow sill; never modeled as a welded bridge plate

surface_crust_provenance.interpretation: A ~3 million km2 surface province cannot plausibly be treated as wholly juvenile 28-18 Ma arc crust. Most substrate is old or reworked continental margin.
The broad corridor is mostly inherited continental substrate; 30-12 Ma dates refer chiefly to assembly, deformation and suturing, not creation of the entire crustal area.
Despite the legacy C5 name, the shelf head is kinematically assigned to the C3 southeast shelf block (GPlates analogue pid 614), not to the C5 nucleus.

hypsometric_accounting.rule: Changed coastline is not equated with newly created/destroyed continental crust. Added land is preferentially emergence of inherited continental/transitional crust; former land is preferentially submerged shelf/platform crust.
hypsometric_accounting.note: The target inventory deliberately tests whether the +7.7% emerged-land increase can be obtained by freeboard redistribution without increasing total continental-crust area.

timeline.state: Six inherited nuclei and old shelf/microcontinental blocks follow Earth-analogue plate circuits; final coastlines do not yet exist.
C4-C3 convergence reorganizes old foreland/microcontinental crust; JX1 arc/microcontinental translation is underway.
JX1 central block is ~8 degrees from its final C1-relative orientation; assembly is deformation/accretion, not wholesale crust generation.
Cached MERDITH2021/MULLER2022 control points constrain inherited rigid circuits; C3 southeast shelf retains only slow residual motion.
JX1 relative angle reduced to ~3 degrees; C4 corridor relative angle ~4 degrees; broad collision/suture networks active.
JX1 central block reaches final C1-relative orientation; ongoing C1-C2 motion is absorbed by the deforming junction.
C4 corridor foreland block reaches final C4-relative orientation; later C3-C4 convergence is internal boundary deformation.
Eastern stepping terranes are small mobile arc/microcontinental blocks on the C3 southeast shelf margin.
JX1 reaches continuous terrestrial-neck state; this is emergence/topography, not continent assembly.
Eastern stepping terranes reach final shelf-relative orientations; all human-route-sensitive synthetic rigid motions are complete before 1.9 Ma.
Human-route ledger begins with continental-scale and gateway-forming relative block geometry frozen; only boundary slip, uplift, subsidence, volcanism and sea-level response continue.

remaining_high_fidelity_requirements: Spatially explicit crustal-thickness and stretching grids for the reworked margins.
Dynamic topological polygons or deforming meshes for JX1 and the C4-C3 collision corridor.
Local bathymetric and isostatic models for the northern and eastern shelves.
A full palaeoelevation/freeboard model to distribute the ~44 million km2 of new land locations and ~33 million km2 of former land locations through time.
Mantle/dynamic-topography modeling is optional unless the freeboard reconstruction cannot close with regional tectonics.
